items.title: Schuller Gunther — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Snooky Young was in his band for years in the show

ctx.x: Oh, Debut. The Debut records that he made for Mingus.

No. This was before that. No, this is about the third recording date that he did, altogether. He said, “You’ve got to hear this,” because John, I think, had played piano on it, or he had already heard it, or whatever. He was right, because that was much, much, much better, including in these technical respects. But still, his tone was not the full blossoming tone that a lot of great trumpet players, like Snooky Young and, my God, I won’t try to think of all the names. They had . . . I got to work with Miles then,…
This is John Lewis talking to Miles.
